data.title: Interim project - Senior DevOps Consultant (f/m/d)
data.description:
Job description

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin.

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions.

The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.

As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders.
Your responsibilities

  • Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work.
  • Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code.
  • Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation.
  • Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure.
  • Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation.
  • Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity.
  • Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance.
  • Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure.


Your profile

Relevant Tech Skills
Required:

  • Python and shell scripting.
  • Linux servers in production.
  • Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent).
  • Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling).
  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design.

data.title: Data Engineer (f/m/d)
data.description:
Job description

We are currently seeking a Data Engineer for our international and diverse Climate Policy Team (CPT). The team is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, the 1.5°C global warming limit and the evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects, such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is being processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.


As a Data Engineer you will play a critical role in designing, building and maintaining our data infrastructure, ensuring efficient and accurate data processing, storage and retrieval. 


Your Responsibilities

  • You will help to build and maintain a data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning data science and data engineering work.

  • Contribute to the full lifecycle of data platform development from design and deployment to continuous improvement

  • Strengthen data pipelines reliability, observability, and automation through code and tooling improvements.

  • Collaborate with data scientists and researchers to define data processing requirements.

  • Support AI/LLM initiatives across the organisation from a data and infrastructure perspective.

  • Help develop backend data services and APIs that expose curated datasets to internal and external consumers and applications.

  • Monitor, anticipate, and resolve operational or data quality issues in data pipelines. Ensure data reliability.


Relevant Tech Skills

Please note that this list is non exhaustive and that if you don’t have experience on some of those you should still apply.


Required:

  • Python

  • SQL

  • PostgreSQL

  • Object storage (like S3/Minio)

  • Containers (like Docker)

  • Git

  • CI/CD principles


Nice to have:

  • Pandas/Polar/DuckDB or other framework for data processing

  • Conda

  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana and Elasticsearch)

  • Infrastructure as code tool (like Terraform or Ansible)

  • AI‑driven productivity tools


Your profile

You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills: 

  • You have a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, ideally with a specialization in Data Engineering or DevOps, or a related field.

  • You have gained initial experience as a Data Engineer in a production environment.

  • Foundational notions in data modeling, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, optimization.

  • Familiarity with the relevant tech skills mentioned above.

  • Basic understanding of data pipelines, APIs, or backend services.

  • Exposure to data engineering in the context of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence across different types of data formats (structured vs unstructured) and processing methods.

  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).

  • A problem solver, a fixer, and a creative technologist. We believe coding is a talent and a passion, not just a skill.

  • A strong communicator and a team player who can work efficiently with others, in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international team.

  • Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.

  • Good communication skills in English


Our offer

  • A job with a purpose. You will work in an international team of highly engaged people and contribute to our work in the field of climate change mitigation

  • A positive and inspiring working atmosphere in an international team. Our Berlin office is located near Moritzplatz in the heart of Kreuzberg

  • Hybrid office policy and flexible start time

  • Fully funded Germany-wide public transport ticket

  • 40 € monthly company contribution to Urban Sports Club membership

  • Online mental health and wellbeing platform

  • Free German language classes

Conditions

  • Start date: As soon as possible

data.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer (f/m/d)
data.description:
ZEAL Network SE is a leading international provider of online lottery products, operating for over 20 years with brands like LOTTO24 and Tipp24. As Germany’s largest digital lottery operator and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, we are passionate about shaping the future of lottery experiences.

 

Freiheit+ is one of ZEAL's new German state-licensed social lottery that gives participants the chance to win €5,000 every month for 15 years, plus a one-time prize of €250,000. Every ticket sold supports educational projects, with at least 30% of proceeds directly funding initiatives for a good cause. Freiheit+ perfectly combines the dream of lifelong financial freedom with the opportunity to make a real difference, reflecting ZEAL’s commitment to offering innovative, socially impactful lottery experiences.

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer (f/m/d), you'll be the guardian of product quality, ensuring our solutions meet the highest standards throughout the entire development lifecycle.

Your tasks:

  • Technically design, develop and maintain automated tests, complemented by manual and exploratory testing, continuously growing our E2E test coverage in step with the product.

  • Collaborate within a dynamic, cross-functional team including a Product Owner, Software Engineers and a Designer in our agile environment, actively contributing to the development of new products and frontends.

  • Own, shape and refine our test strategies for the frontend, prioritizing based on risk and business impact, with a keen focus on delivering a seamless user experience for our customers while preventing any unwelcome surprises.

  • Proactively communicate test coverage, quality status and risks, enabling the team to make informed delivery decisions.

  • Act according to security, usability, and performance best practices to guarantee a superb user experience.

  • Own, expand and nurture our E2E test pipeline, keeping it stable, fast and reliable, and enabling tests for other teams while offering our own tests for integration into their pipelines.

  • Continuously improve our tests using new technologies and approaches.

  • Build a solid functional and high-level technical understanding of company-wide processes to effectively test complex user flows and identify edge cases.

What you offer us:

  • Several years of experience and a strong background in testing web applications.

  • Extensive hands-on experience in creating and maintaining automated frontend tests.

  • Thinking outside the box and exploring multiple ways to test, including E2E UI tests, accessibility, page performance, and more.

  • Active communication and collaboration with other QAs to share knowledge, exchange best practices, and learn from each other.

  • Proficiency in the Playwright test framework using TypeScript, or comparable hands-on experience with other modern E2E frameworks such as Cypress.

  • Experience in maintaining and improving CI/CD test pipelines, including diagnosing and resolving flaky tests.

  • A solid grasp of working within a microservices environment where features are frequently and rapidly released (continuous delivery).

data.title: QA Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world—moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can't solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we're looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced and proactive QA Engineer to own product quality across our AI robotics platform. In this role, you will be responsible for conceptualizing and driving the overall testing strategy, building quality into every stage of our development lifecycle, and ensuring our robotic systems meet the highest standards before reaching customers. You will work across hardware and software boundaries, collaborating closely with engineering, product, and support teams in a fast-paced startup environment.

Your Responsibilities

Testing Strategy & Quality Gates

  • Conceptualize, develop, and manage the overall testing strategy and quality gates for the product.

  • Define and enforce release criteria, ensuring that only thoroughly validated builds reach production.

  • Establish and maintain quality metrics and dashboards to provide visibility into product health.

QA Ownership

  • Own QA processes across both hardware and software, ensuring quality is built into the development lifecycle from the start.

  • Design and implement test plans, test cases, and test automation for new features and existing functionality.

  • Conduct and oversee functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing of robotic systems.

  • Work closely with developers to reproduce, isolate, and resolve defects efficiently.

Systematic Validation & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish systematic validation and regression testing frameworks that scale with the product.

  • Identify gaps in test coverage and drive initiatives to close them.

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements by integrating automated testing at appropriate stages.

  • Advocate for quality best practices across the organization and mentor team members on testing methodologies.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree (Master's preferred) in Computer Science, Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field.

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of professional experience in QA engineering or software testing, preferably in a product-focused environment.

  • Proven track record of building and owning testing strategies and QA processes.

Wer wir sind?

Seit 2007 beweisen wir bei ARMEDANGELS, dass Mode auch anders geht: innovativ und zeitlos, produziert nach verantwortungsvollen Standards für Mensch und Erde. Keine Lohnsklaverei, keine schädlichen Chemikalien, keine billige Massenware. Aus der einfachen Idee, T-Shirts zu bedrucken und über den Verkauf Spendengelder für Projekte und Organisationen zu sammeln, ist ein Unternehmen gewachsen, das heute zu den größten nachhaltigeren Lifestyle Labels Europas zählt. data.title: Senior Controller (all genders)
data.description:
Want to make a difference?

As Senior Controller (all genders), you play a key role in the financial steering of ARMEDANGELS. With your strategic perspective on numbers, processes, and business performance, you help ensure that sustainable growth is built on a strong and reliable financial foundation.

You take ownership of further developing budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes, create transparency around financial performance, and support data-driven decision-making across the business. In doing so, you combine financial excellence with our ambition to operate responsibly and with long-term impact in mind.


Who we are...

Since 2007, ARMEDANGELS has been proving that fashion can be different: innovative and timeless, produced according to responsible standards for people and planet. No wage slavery, no toxic chemicals, no cheap throwaway goods.

What started as a simple idea – printing T-shirts and donating proceeds to social projects – has grown into a company that now ranks among Europe’s leading sustainable lifestyle labels. With a 190-strong team and four collections a year, we show that responsibility and great product design can go hand in hand.


What is the job about?

Strategic Financial Planning & Analysis

You lead and further develop our budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes, ensuring they are aligned with our business and growth objectives.

You analyze financial performance, conduct variance analyses, and derive actionable recommendations to support better business decisions.

Internal Controls & Compliance

You will develop and strengthen internal control mechanisms, helping to identify risks early on and ensure compliance with regulatory and internal standards. 

You will assist with annual financial statement audits in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB), participate in audits, and, when necessary, coordinate the implementation of required measures from a controlling perspective.

Financial Reporting & Performance Monitoring

You oversee the preparation of meaningful financial reports, including P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet analysis, creating transparency on the company’s financial performance.

You use KPIs and data-driven insights to identify opportunities and support financial steering.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Support

You work closely with Finance, Operations, IT, and other business functions to integrate financial insights into broader business planning.

You prepare decision-ready analyses for senior stakeholders and help ensure strategic choices are grounded in reliable financial data.

Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement

You support and develop colleagues in Finance and Controlling, fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement.

You drive process enhancements and introduce tools, methods, and best practices that improve efficiency and quality in a sustainable way.


We'd love to hear from you if you have

Professional

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 5–7+ years of experience in controlling, financial planning, or comparable finance roles
  • Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting
  • Proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and financial management software.  Experience with analytics tools such as Looker, PowerBI, or Tableau is a plus
  • Experience with internal controls and compliance-related processes
  • You have knowledge of the German Commercial Code (HGB) and a solid understanding of accounting principles, enabling you to effectively integrate controlling and accounting perspectives.
Personal
  • Strategic and analytical mindset
  • Structured, precise, and solution-oriented way of working
  • Strong sense of ownership and responsibility
  • Excellent communication skills and confidence in working with different stakeholders
  • Motivation to support teams and actively improve processes


What can you expect?

Inspiring work environment: Work in an innovative company that operates as sustainably as possible and continuously sets new standards.

Flexibility: Trust-based working hours and the option to work in a hybrid setup.

Team spirit: Enjoy legendary team events, a historic office space, and plenty of dog-friendly energy.

Benefits: €50 monthly benefit via guudcard, ARMEDANGELS shopping vouchers, attractive employee discounts, a JobRad or Germany Ticket, and a company pension scheme.

Support: Our Employee Assistance Program is available to support you confidentially in any life situation.

Come as you are: No dress code – just be yourself.


Good to know before you apply

We appreciate diverse interests, courage, and the drive to make things happen.

Please apply online via the application button and include the following information:

  • Your pronouns and preferred name, if applicable
  • Your CV
  • Your earliest possible start date and salary expectations
  • A few words on why you are excited to join ARMEDANGELS

This helps us get a well-rounded picture of how well we might fit together.

Thank you for your time and interest!

data.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance & Beratung (unternehmerisch, leistungsbasiert)
data.description:
Du studierst und willst mehr als einen „Nebenjob“? Du willst Verantwortung, klare Ziele und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung zählt? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm.

Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Startphase (erste Wochen):

  • Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf.

  • Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards.

  • Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse.

Im weiteren Verlauf:

  • Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor.

  • Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte.

  • Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher.

  • Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards

  • Mentoring & Coaching: regelmäßiges Feedback, klare Ziele

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt)

  • Skalierbare Perspektive: Option auf Übernahme ins Trainee-Programm

  • Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr”

  • Team mit Performance-Kultur: klare Kommunikation, klare Ergebnisse


Nichts für dich, wenn…

  • du einen typischen Werkstudentenjob mit “ein paar Stunden nebenbei” suchst

  • du Telefon/Terminaufbau vermeiden willst

  • dein Deutsch unter C1 liegt

  • du lieber Sicherheit als Entwicklung priorisierst

Muss

data.title: (Senior) Finance & Accounting Manager (f/m/d) – bunch capital
data.description:
We are recruiting for this position on behalf of our partner, bunch capital.

bunch is building the backbone of private markets, enabling next-generation fund operations through one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows, and expert fund services.

If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful and ambitious team, this role might be for you.

bunch is looking for a (Senior) Finance & Accounting Manager to be the backbone of its day-to-day financial operations.
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the intersection of accounting, billing, payroll, and process improvement. You will be responsible for key financial operations, including preparatory accounting (vorbereitende Buchhaltung), spend management, and client invoicing across all bunch entities.
We are looking for someone with a strong accounting foundation who has expanded – or would like to further expand – into broader finance topics and take on more responsibility across the finance function.

You will gain direct exposure to the full finance function of a fast-growing fintech, report directly to the Head of Finance, and have the opportunity to grow your role within the Finance Team over time. Candidates with appropriate senior-level experience may join at Senior Manager level.

From day one, you will play a critical role in strengthening and optimising bunch’s financial operations as the company grows and scales across markets.


What You’ll Do

  • Handle all our preparatory accounting (including assigning cost centers and cost units) on both the creditor and debtor side (Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung) and be responsible for exports to our external accountants in all our jurisdictions
  • Own our spend management processes, including weekly invoice review and approval, credit card and employee reimbursement management, and direct debit setup, and make sure we pay our bills on time
  • Run quarterly and annual invoicing across all products and jurisdictions and take the lead on reducing manual effort by working with our analytics and other teams to improve and automate our invoicing setup. You'll also track client payments and flag overdue accounts
  • Support our monthly close by coordinating with external accountants across all jurisdictions and entities, ensuring timely delivery of monthly and annual accounts and that our external partners always have what they need on time
  • Support on our regular tax filings, such as for VAT, across our entities
  • Conduct monthly payroll reviews and serve as the internal point of contact for payroll-related questions — including social security, health insurance, pension contributions, and employee benefits — as well as financial employee policies such as expense reimbursement
  • Support equity financing rounds alongside Legal, Strategy, and FP&A — including due diligence and data room preparation. You'll also pick up one-off banking and insurance needs as they arise


What you bring

  •  At least 2–4 years of experience in an in-house finance role, reputable consultancy, or completed training as a tax clerk (Steuerfachangestellte/r) or accountant (Bilanzbuchhalter/in). This role has flexibility in its seniority — for more senior candidates beyond 5-6 years experience, we can offer a “Senior Manager” role
  • Mastery of the fundamentals of accounting and familiarity with common tax issues arising in a multi-jurisdictional company
  • Hands-on experience with accounting, billing, and spend management tools (e.g. DATEV, Stripe, Moss, Spendesk) or similar systems
  • Highly organised and reliable, with a track record of owning recurring processes independently
  • Genuine interest in process optimisation and automation — you notice inefficiencies and want to fix them
  • Strong attention to detail and quality orientation
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and comfort handling new responsibilities
  • High level of ownership, reliability, and flexibility
  • SaaS and/or fund industry experience is a plus
  • Fluency in English (C1+ level), at least B1 in German
  • Be excited about working in a fluid, innovative, fast-paced, and creative environment and about being a part of bunch's culture
  • Diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged


What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)
  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays
  • Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office)
  • Up to 4 remote calendar weeks a year
  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains


Hiring process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & ensure mutual fit
  2. Deep Dive Interview (45 min) – Collaboration, ownership, and culture
  3. Case Study (90 min) – Technical skillset evaluation with our hiring manager
  4. Final Stakeholder Interview (60 min) – Meet your important stakeholders


Contact information

Interested? We look forward to hearing from you!

data.description:
Up to £100,000 depending on experience

📍 Salary based on London. Hybrid, with flexible hours.

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Growth engineering at Fanvue exists to move core product metrics fast. It's a small team that reads out experiments every week, and the surface area is enormous: signup, onboarding, activation, referral loops, retention, and the funnels underneath all of them. There is far more worth testing than there are people to test it. This role exists to close that gap.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Full Stack Engineer to work on Fanvue's Growth streams, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data and Marketing to design, ship and iterate on high-impact experiments across acquisition, onboarding, activation and retention.

This is highly execution-focused. You'll be testing ideas in production within your first weeks, not writing specs about them. The team runs on a weekly experiment cadence with real readouts, so the loop between an idea and knowing whether it worked is short, and you own both ends of it.

It suits someone who wants to be judged on whether the metric moved.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Design, build and ship growth experiments across signup, onboarding, activation and retention flows

  • Own features end to end, from idea through implementation, measurement and iteration

  • Build and refine growth loops such as referrals, sharing mechanics and viral surfaces

  • Run A/B and multivariate tests, and read the results honestly, including the ones that kill your own idea

  • Partner with Product and Design to prioritise and scope what's worth testing

  • Improve the performance and reliability of growth-critical user journeys

  • Use analytics and data tooling to guide technical and product decisions

  • Continuously find and remove friction in creator and fan funnels

👀 Who You Are

  • Strong full stack engineering experience with a clear bias toward shipping

  • Comfortable across frontend and backend, and willing to go wherever the problem is

  • Experienced with modern web stacks such as TypeScript, Node.js, React and relational databases

  • Familiar with experimentation frameworks, analytics tooling and funnel metrics

  • Comfortable in ambiguity, with a strong bias toward action

  • Data-informed and outcome-driven rather than feature-focused

  • A clear communicator who works well with product, design and growth partners

  • High ownership, high agency, and an appetite for fast iteration

Nice to have

  • Experience in the creator economy, consumer subscription, marketplaces or social platforms

  • Hands-on with Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog or similar

  • A track record of growth loops you built that are still running

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You'd rather ship a scrappy test this week than a polished one next quarter

  • You want to be measured on whether the number moved, not on what you delivered

  • You're happy to kill your own experiment when the data says so

  • You go and find the opportunity rather than waiting for it to arrive as a ticket

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You prefer long planning cycles to fast iteration

  • You need tightly defined requirements before you can start

  • You optimise for technical purity over measurable impact

  • You're uncomfortable with a roadmap that changes when the results say it should

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Ship work that directly moves growth, activation and revenue, and see it in the numbers the same week

  • Work at the intersection of product, data and engineering, with high visibility across the business

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Budget for growth and wellbeing, plus support with upskilling and development costs

  • A culture built on innovation, speed, excellence, ownership and transparency

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It's faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We're backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for core areas of Paddle's product suite.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role at the heart of our marketing function. You will be the connective tissue between Product, Sales, and Marketing translating deep customer and market insight into commercially sharp narratives that drive awareness, conversion, and revenue.

You'll shape how we go to market, how we equip our sales teams to win, and how we position Paddle for differentiation. The most successful candidate will be a master at aligning launch objectives to commercial value, connecting every GTM motion directly to business outcomes. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you'll lead complex cross-functional workstreams, use data and AI-powered tools to accelerate your craft, influence strategic decisions, and mentor peers across the team.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy and craft: a rigorous thinker who can also write a killer one-pager, run a crisp competitive briefing, and land a product launch with measurable impact.

What you'll do

Own positioning and messaging
- Develop and maintain differentiated positioning and messaging for key product areas, grounded in deep customer, market, and competitive insight.

- Translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling narratives tailored to distinct buyer segments and personas.

- Ensure message consistency across all touchpoints website, sales collateral, campaigns, and executive communications.

Drive go-to-market strategy and execution
- Lead end-to-end GTM strategy for major product launches, from discovery and segmentation through to launch and post-launch measurement.

- Define launch objectives, success metrics, and cross-functional plans in partnership with Product, Sales, and Marketing teams always anchored to commercial & business outcomes

Enable the commercial team

Be the voice of the customer and market
- Design and run qualitative and quantitative research programmes (win/loss interviews, customer surveys, persona studies) to develop a deep understanding of buyer motivations, pain points, and decision-making.

- Own competitive intelligence for your product area, tracking competitor moves, synthesising insights, and equipping the business to respond.

- Surface customer and market insights to influence product strategy and roadmap prioritisation.

Shape category and brand narrative
- Contribute to Paddle's broader category positioning and thought leadership strategy in collaboration with Brand and Content teams.

- Partner with the executive team on key narratives for analyst relations, investor communications, and major industry moments.

Measure and prove commercial impact
- Own the PMM measurement framework for your area: define success metrics for positioning work, product launches, and sales enablement that connect directly to business outcomes

- Bring a data-first mindset to every strategic decision: use quantitative signals alongside qualitative insight to prioritise, adjust, and prove impact.

Accelerate with AI and agents
- Use AI tools and agents actively to compress research cycles from competitive monitoring and win/loss synthesis to persona development, message testing, and brief generation.

- Experiment with emerging agentic tooling to automate repeatable PMM tasks, freeing capacity for higher-leverage strategic work.

- Share AI workflows, prompts, and best practices with the wider PMM team to raise productivity and capability across the function.

Mentor and raise the bar
- Act as an informal leader and mentor to more junior PMMs, sharing frameworks, reviewing work, and helping the team grow.

- Contribute to the development of team processes, playbooks, and standards that improve the quality and velocity of PMM output.

- An experienced product marketer with 8+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally in payments, fintech, or developer/platform tooling.

TL;DR: Lovable's growth marketing runs on creative. The volume, variety, and quality of concepts we put in front of people, and how fast what we learn from them turns into the next round. Your job is to own that loop end to end, constantly iterating on it to achieve the best results against your KPIs.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • You've run high-volume creative testing on performance marketing and can talk specifically about what you learned, not just what you shipped.

  • You use AI tools daily and have built something with them that other people now depend on. A workflow, an agent, an internal tool, a tagging pipeline.

  • You have opinions about what makes an ad work and can articulate them well.

  • You write well for ads. Briefs, hooks, scripts etc.

  • You're comfortable being wrong in public. A lot of tests lose, and the loop only works if we’re all comfortable with that.

  • You move fast, but balance that with exceptional craft and know where the balance is.

What you’ll do

You'll be the person who decides what we test, why, and what the results mean. Then you'll build the workflows that turn those answers into hundreds of assets a month without losing the taste that made them work in the first place.

  • Own the creative operating system. You run creative ops for performance marketing: intake, briefing, production, QA, launch, and post-mortem. You'll define how the process works and then automate the parts that don't need a human in the loop.

  • Be the creative performance decision maker. When we can produce hundreds of creatives, you’ll be the person to judge what we make more of, what gets killed and what to slightly edit. That means holding the creative standard high, and making sure that creatives generated look Lovable.

  • Build agentic workflows and keep improving them. You'll design pipelines that generate, adapt, and localise creative at volume, with evals to check quality before anything ships. When a workflow breaks, you diagnose it and help rebuild it.

  • Turn performance data, audience insights and product knowledge into concepts. You'll dig into what's actually driving results, hook, format, message, subject, pacing, offer, and separate the signal from the noise a low-spend winner creates.

  • Run brainstorms and briefing. You own the rhythm that takes learnings, customer language, competitor moves, product releases, and additional context, and works with the wider team to turn them into briefs.

  • Push learnings across the company. What wins on paid usually tells us something about the website, lifecycle emails, App Store listings, and organic content. You'll be the one making sure that reaches the relevant people so we become more informed collectively.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

data.description:
Revenue Operations Manager

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 2 days WFH) | 💰 Up to £70,000


Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everyone by elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.


Your job is to own the numbers for the entire commercial engine. Not hit them, own them. You'll build the single version of the truth that runs our marketing, sales and customer success functions, and put a reliable set of numbers in front of our leadership team and board.


You will take accountability for the integrity of the full commercial funnel from top-of-funnel marketing through to churn and renewals. Right now, each function applies its own definitions and rules. You'll set one consistent set of rules and make them stick across the entire business. You'll also be responsible for forecasting, headcount planning and supporting the design of commission structures.


This is a hands-on, senior operator role. You'll own the tech stack (HubSpot sits at the centre), and you'll build the workflows, automations and permissions that keep data clean at source. You're not tidying records by hand; you're designing systems. You'll also be working with AI daily – it's not optional here. We use Claude, and you'll need to show evidence of AI already embedded in how you work.


There are no commissions or bonuses in this role and that is deliberate. The role has to stay objective about what the figures say. We've positioned the salary to reflect both your seniority and the independence you'll need to challenge senior leaders professionally and diplomatically when the numbers don't match the narrative.

HERE'S WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO BE WORKING ON


  • Building and maintaining complete visibility across the entire revenue line: marketing pipeline, sales pipeline, churn and renewals, and capacity planning.

  • Setting and enforcing a single set of definitions and rules across marketing, sales and customer success, then making them stick.

  • Owning HubSpot end-to-end: permissions, day-to-day usage, workflow build, automations and the processes that keep data clean at source.

  • Producing forecasts, headcount plans and reporting that the leadership team can actually rely on.

  • Contributing to the design of commission plans and commercial structures.

  • Supporting the hiring and onboarding of a Sales Operations person, and training them to maintain what you've built.

  • Presenting to the board, with numbers that are clean, consistent and defensible.

  • Using AI to solve problems that would otherwise drown you in manual work.

  • Joining up the revenue line with the wider business (think product, finance, and marketing) so everybody's working from the same playbook.

WHY YOU SHOULD (AND SHOULDN'T) APPLY

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF:

  • You've owned reporting across a full commercial funnel (not just the sales pipeline). You can point to a forecast you owned, a commission plan you shaped and workflows you built yourself.

  • HubSpot is second nature to you. You operate at expert or power-user level and you can configure permissions, automations and processes without breaking into a sweat.

  • You've worked in multi-product SaaS at a senior level and you understand how different product lines affect pipeline, ARR and churn.

  • AI is already woven into how you work. You can give concrete examples of which tools you use, what you've built with them, and how they've changed your process significantly.

  • You can challenge senior leaders diplomatically but firmly, and you're not afraid to report the numbers as they actually are, not as people hope they'll be.

  • You work best with autonomy. You're a self-starter who gets the work done yourself, not someone who needs to manage others to feel productive.

  • You'd rather build something new than inherit a legacy system, and you're excited by the chance to define how commercial operations should work.


YOU PROBABLY SHOULDN'T APPLY IF:

  • You've spent your career managing the sales pipeline in isolation, without visibility into marketing and customer success.

  • You'd struggle with HubSpot or you'd need somebody else to handle the tech stack. This is not negotiable, unfortunately.

  • You need variable pay to feel motivated. Commission and bonus structures feel essential to you.

  • AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. You see it as something that reduces your value, not something that multiplies what you can deliver.

  • You need a large team beneath you from day one. This role starts solo and hands-on, though you'll build a team over time.

  • You'd rather build strategy than do the work. The first six months are about delivery—designing the systems, building the reports, making it stick—not sitting in planning meetings.


A BIT ABOUT YOU

Experience

You've spent time in a revenue operations, commercial operations or similar role, with demonstrable ownership of the full commercial funnel. You've done the work yourself – like configuring HubSpot, building forecasts, and leading alignment conversations across functions. Multi-product SaaS experience is non-negotiable; B2B exposure is strongly preferred.

 

Tooling

HubSpot sits at the centre, and you're an expert here. Experience with other platforms, such as Salesforce or Pipedrive, is a plus (some skills transfer). You're comfortable across other tech stacks and you use AI regularly as part of your workflow. Other tools in the stack will change and you're flexible on that front.


Communication

You can present to senior audiences without losing clarity. You push back on senior leaders when the numbers don't match the narrative, and you do it diplomatically enough that they listen rather than push back harder. You explain complex commercial logic in plain language.


Research

You think operationally. You diagnose what's broken in a process, you ask tough questions about data quality, and you can identify which problems to tackle first based on commercial impact. You're curious about how the business actually works, not just the metrics.


We recognise that women and people from underrepresented groups often only apply for jobs when they meet every single one of the requirements listed. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

data.title: Associate Relationship Manager - London
data.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. Allica’s Relationship Management team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow at pace, providing established SME customers with expert human relationships alongside modern banking technology.

The team supports customers with lending, current accounts, savings, asset finance and working capital facilities, while building deep local relationships with SME customers, trusted professional advisers and business communities.

The Associate Relationship Manager role is a newly created position that is a key step in our ambition to build the best Relationship team to support our SME clients. The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients and be expected to deliver across a range of commercial, customer service and risk objectives whilst also providing support to the wider relationship team as part of their development.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and progress a career as an SME Relationship Manager.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Manage a portfolio of SME customers delivering outstanding customer service, building genuine and trusting relationships and develop a deep understanding of your clients’ businesses and their ambitions.

  • Deliver against a range of commercial targets including lending and new customer / deposit acquisition, as well as identifying and meeting a range of client needs through the provision of Allica products and services.

  • Build a trusted external network with SME advisers and the wider business community. Leverage this network to generate new business opportunities for the bank, in addition to signposting your clients to external support and advice as appropriate.

  • Ensure that Risk is managed effectively on your portfolio, with all required risk activities completed on time and to a high standard. Use customer data and internal Allica systems to identify signs of client stress and take proactive action to tackle early.

  • Work closely with a Senior Relationship Manager, contributing to building a bespoke personal development plan which will include supporting them and the wider team as part of your learning.

  • Take an active role in new business campaigns, including attending events, following up on leads, supporting prospect engagement and undertaking some cold calling where appropriate.

  • Support event organisation and follow-up activity, helping the team build strong local relationships with SME customers, prospects, accountants, solicitors and other trusted professional advisers.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, strong follow-up discipline and good control over customer, prospect and portfolio activity.

  • Build strong, collaborative and productive relationships with your team and wider internal stakeholders to ensure customer needs are meet efficiently and any issues resolved quickly.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Some B2B sales, account management and/or SME banking experience, with a clear interest in building a career in SME relationship banking and a passion for supporting SMEs to be more successful.

  • Some experience of commercial lending and understanding / analysing financial accounts would be of benefit.

  • Curious, proactive and keen to learn, with the motivation to develop lending, sales, risk management and portfolio management capability through formal training and on-the-job coaching.

  • Confident engaging with customers, prospects and SME business advisers (including in person, via video call and by phone) asking great questions, following up consistently and building professional relationships.

  • Good organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage customer information and requests, portfolio tasks and follow-up actions accurately and at pace.

  • Practical understanding of customer service, sales activity and account management disciplines, ideally gained in a B2B, financial services or relationship-led environment.

  • Confident using systems, CRM tools and data to manage activity, track progress and support strong customer and risk outcomes.

  • Experience using AI tools in a business environment would also be of benefit.

  • An energetic, resilient, hands-on approach, with the confidence to get into the detail, solve problems and take ownership of outcomes.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with customers, prospects, advisers, colleagues and stakeholders.

  • Strong alignment to Allica’s values, with the judgement, integrity and energy to lead by example and help contribute to the next phase of the Direct Relationship Management channel.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

Role Description

The Securities & Redemptions Officer plays a key role in the effective management of post completion activities, undertaking all relevant post completion requirements relating to all Allica Lending products. Including, for example, Land Registry checks, Redemptions, Releases, Lease reviews and annual reviews.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Supporting the Team Lead with Securities and Redemption.

  • Delegated authority – this could be for agreed 4eye checks, redemption sign offs, lease reviews.

  • First point of contact for Securities and Redemption queries, triaging before hand off to team Lead.

  • Reviewing procedure guides to ensure up to date processes are captured.

  • Act as the first point of contact for Securities and Redemption queries.

  • Support the Team Lead on key functions like redemption sign-offs, lease reviews, and procedural updates.

  • Contact customers and/or professional advisors for required information.

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Department Description

Allica Bank aims to provide Expert Banking for Business Britain by providing excellent customer experience and pioneering technology solutions to facilitate this.

The Autonomous Lending tribe runs across multiple business lines including Credit Operations and Underwriting, with a mission to build AI-first lending origination journeys, automating origination capabilities, data flows, and underwriting and operational workflow management.

The tribe is a critical driver for Allica to continue to realise its vision of providing a market leading relationship-based banking experience, at a speed and cost to serve the rest of the market cannot match.

Role Description
The Product Owner will lead the work to define, deliver and manage AI-enabled products across our lending journeys, bringing together product design and thinking with a strong working knowledge of what today’s AI can and cannot do.

You will be accountable for the roadmap of your team and for the full product lifecycle: discovery and design, day-to-day delivery, launch and adoption by colleagues and customers, and how risks are addressed once a product is live. You will aim to build robust, automated and well-governed systems and processes that enable us to move quickly and innovate our lending and financing products in the SME banking market.

Whilst a lot of the market aims to avoid the complex nature of SME businesses, we are going for it head on, designing simple and efficient solutions to the most complex problems in the market to provide excellent and efficient customer experience.   • Prototype and experiment quickly – vibe-code working prototypes yourself, close enough to the real thing that an engineer can harden it into production code

  • Determine the accuracy of AI solutions by analysing the data yourself and building the verified “ground truth” datasets that results are tested against, working with underwriters and credit operations colleagues to agree what a correct answer looks like

  • Produce the written work that keeps delivery moving and safe – clear descriptions of what we are building and why, a record of the important design decisions and trade-offs made, and the assessments needed to get a product approved and live, covering risk, security, cost, data and legal considerations, and taking the change through the bank’s governance and approval process

data.description:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

This is not a traditional accounting role focused on maintaining legacy systems.

At Volta, you will help build the finance function from first principles, contributing to the design of processes, controls, and reporting in a business deploying capital at global scale.

Working closely with the Senior Financial Accountant and the wider Financial Accounting and Transactional Function, you will play a key role in delivering accurate financial reporting while supporting the build-out of a scalable, best-in-class accounting environment across multiple jurisdictions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the execution of the monthly financial close

  • Prepare and post accrual, prepayment, payroll, capex, revenue, and FX entries, among others

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations for review

    • Cash, AR, AP, fixed assets, other payables and receivables, equity

  • Support transactional processing

    • Approvals, audit trail, and clean ledgers

    • Intercompany accounting and cross charges

  • Support internal financial reporting

    • Assist in monthly reporting packages

    • Support the analysis of variance to budget and prior periods

  • Track capital spend and asset capitalization

  • Support external reporting

    • Support external audits and act as a key point of contact for auditors

    • Prepare support for auditors

  • Contribute to the implementation and optimization of ERP/accounting systems

  • Assist with tax compliance, indirect tax (e.g., VAT/sales tax) returns, and regulatory filings across jurisdictions

  • Maintain and enhance the general ledger and chart of accounts

Requirements

data.description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. You will work with the Audiobooks Analytics Lead to help shape our global audiobooks strategy and improve the experience for listeners, creators, publishers, and authors.

In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to evaluate some of the most important opportunities facing our audiobooks business. Your work will span content and catalog strategy, discovery and recommendations, subscriber growth, and new product and commercial initiatives. You will turn complex questions into clear recommendations and help senior leaders make confident decisions.

You will collaborate with a distributed team of analysts, data scientists, business leaders, product managers, editorial partners, and engineers. At Spotify, you will have access to rich datasets and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will help shape how the world listens to and discovers audiobooks.


What You'll Do
  • Develop data-driven strategies for audiobook catalog, content discovery, listener engagement, and subscriber growth.
  • Evaluate new product, content, licensing, and commercial opportunities through forecasting, scenario modeling, and impact measurement.
  • Partner with Editorial, Personalization, Product, Finance, and Business teams to improve title selection, recommendation quality, and the listener experience.
  • Design and analyze experiments, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments, to measure the impact of product and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Monitor the health of the audiobooks business, identify emerging opportunities or risks, and translate them into clear recommendations.
  • Develop reliable analytical datasets, tools, and reporting that make important insights accessible and repeatable.
  • Work with analytics engineering and data partners to improve data quality and create scalable ways of working.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior leaders, influencing the direction of our product and business.

    • Who You Are
  • You have 3+ years of professional experience in data science or analytics, ideally in consumer technology, media, subscriptions, marketplaces, or a similarly complex business.
  • You are fluent in SQL and proficient in Python, R, or another programming language, with a strong grasp of statistical methods, experimentation, and causal inference.
  • You combine analytical rigor with strong business judgment and can cleanly extract the “so what” from complex analysis.
  • You are comfortable working through ambiguous problems, structuring open-ended questions, and identifying a practical path forward.
  • You enjoy collaborating with a wide range of cross-functional partners and can build trust across technical and non-technical teams.
  • You are an excellent communicator who can present complex findings clearly to senior leaders and audiences with different levels of technical knowledge.
  • You have a degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with product analytics, recommendation systems, content businesses, or digital marketplaces is a plus.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London.

We want a structured operator with low ego and a builder's instinct. You'd rather automate a problem than write a process doc about it. You'll be hands-on — wiring up integrations, writing Claude skills, pulling data, shipping dashboards.

What Can You Expect?

AI enablement for the product team. You'll work out where PMs, designers and engineers are spending time they shouldn't, then build the agents, Claude skills and automations that take it off them: synthesising customer signal from Gong, Slack and support, turning specs into first drafts, generating release notes, assembling reporting. Getting people to use what you build matters as much as building it, so expect to spend real time on adoption and coaching. Hold yourself to whether the team is measurably faster.

The product tool stack. Claude (incl skills), Figma, Linear, Notion, Pylon, Mixpanel, Datadog, Granola, our AI tooling, whatever comes next. You own how it's configured, how it connects and how well it's used. Kill what isn't earning its licence. Run the evaluation when we need something new. Connect them up so nobody's copy-pasting between systems. And structure our sources of truth — roadmap data, decision logs, product knowledge — so agents can read them as well as people can.

Launch and release coordination. The product launch calendar, readiness criteria, and a reliable record of what shipped when. The important part is the join between what we build and how we sell it. Product Marketing owns the narrative and the campaign and marketing release timing; you own the reality underneath it. You’ll know the product inside & out, you’ll ensure that the thing we're announcing has actually shipped, works, is documented for internal teams and customer, and a customer can use it on day one. Nothing goes out before it's ready. Nothing meaningful ships without the market hearing about it.

Early access programmes. Alpha, beta and design partner programmes are how we de-risk what we build and how our best customers get a stake in the roadmap. They run informally today. As we sell to bigger and more demanding enterprises they need proper structure: who gets in, what both sides commit to, how feedback gets captured and routed, and what has to be true before something goes GA. You'll design that and mature it as our customer base does.

Top-level metrics. PMs own the detail for their own areas and should keep owning it. You own the layer above: our North Star and company-level product metrics, the key metric from each team pulled into one picture, kept current and actually looked at. You’ll shape the narrative around the metrics and work with PMs to connect the detail into the company level. You'll bring in the signals from outside product that should be shaping decisions — pipeline and what we're winning on, customer health, how people really use what we've shipped. Board and investor materials should pull from your view rather than getting rebuilt from scratch every quarter.

Product comms, including the roadmap deck. The internal newsletter, release notifications, release tracking. As we ship faster this becomes the difference between a business that's aligned and one that's guessing — Sales, Customer and Marketing should never be surprised by something we've shipped. You'll also own our external-facing roadmap deck, used with prospects and customers and as an internal alignment tool.

Documentation. Integration guides, technical docs and product reference material that get used live in sales cycles and onboarding. You'll keep them accurate as the product grows, you’ll track their adoption and adjust.

How the product team comes together. A team growing this fast needs coherence. You'll run our quarterly or semi-annual product events, and wider R&D events where it makes sense, with a real agenda and a real outcome rather than a day of slides. You'll also own our learning rhythm: lunch and learns, internal teach-ins, and getting good external speakers in from other product orgs.

About You

  • You've spent 2 to 3 years in product operations, product management, business operations, strategy and ops, consulting or a chief-of-staff role, ideally in B2B SaaS. The strongest candidates will have done more than one of those, and will have built the systems they ran rather than inherited them.

  • AI is already how you work. Not something you're planning to get to. You use it instinctively, and more usefully, you know how to design systems that leverage it for other people. You've built agents, automations or internal tools that others adopted and kept using. You can get to a working prototype without waiting for engineering.

  • You're comfortable with data. You can pull it, interrogate it and turn it into something a PM will act on.

  • You're a systems thinker. You know the difference between a process problem and a structural one, and when to optimise versus when to redesign.

  • You write well. You can take a roadmap, a release, or a pile of signals from across the business and make it land with people who didn't build it.

  • You can hold an event with a lot of moving parts and senior people in it, and land it.

  • You have experience in a start up or scale-up environment.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Dev Environments
data.description:
The Dev Environments team sits within DoorDash's Foundations group (Platform Engineering). We own the local and remote developer experience across the DoorDash group of companies supporting over 5000 engineers. Our mission is to enable engineering velocity, quality, and efficiency at significant scale by removing friction from the day-to-day developer loop: spinning up a working environment, getting code building, and getting feedback fast, whether the "developer" is a human or an AI agent.

As a Staff Engineer on Dev Environments, you'll be recognised as an expert across the dev environments space, covering both local and remote dev flows, devcontainers, IDE/remote backends, and how they all fit together, including owning accountability for outcomes that span multiple teams. You'll set technical direction for the team's roadmap, unblock deep cross-cutting technical problems other engineers can't resolve alone, and mentor senior and mid-level engineers. You'll partner closely with engineering leadership across the group to translate ambiguous, company-wide developer-experience problems into a concrete, sequenced technical strategy.

What You’ll Be Doing

Technical direction

  • Define the architecture for how thousands of engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo actually develop and ship code: local and remote dev containers, remote IDE/VM lifecycle, and the full local-to-remote loop.

  • Build monorepo dev tooling at scale. It's part of consolidating all the companies under DoorDash’s umbrella onto one global backend - you're setting the standard, not patching one org's tooling.

  • Provision production-shaped environments in seconds, keep state in sync over the network, and make a remote machine feel local, reliably and cheaply, at thousands-of-concurrent-engineers scale.

  • Expect to invent as much as you adopt: much of this is genuinely unsolved elsewhere in the industry.

  • Design for AI agents as first-class consumers of the environment, not an afterthought: sandboxes that spin up on demand, run in parallel, and are safe to hand a real repo.

  • Support agents launched from an IDE, a CLI, or a Slack message - with no laptop required to review and ship what the agent did.

Collaboration & leadership

  • Align teams that don't naturally sit adjacent to each other (e.g. Security, Infrastructure, Product Engineering) around unstructured, ambiguous problems where there's no existing playbook.

  • Mentor engineers at all levels: run design reviews; raise the engineering bar through code review, pairing, and architectural guidance when appropriate.

  • Help set the hiring bar: lead interview loops, help calibrate, and support onboarding of senior hires.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential:

  • A track record of shipping production systems and leading cross-team initiatives with group level impact - comfortable owning delivery end to end, from design through to production and adoption.

  • Hands on fluency with the languages and tooling used to build developer tooling (e.g. Go, Python, TypeScript) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).

  • Experience managing compute via Kubernetes (multi-tenant workload isolation, autoscaling ephemeral workloads, cost management), or lightweight VM/sandbox technology (e.g. Firecracker).

  • Working knowledge of cloud networking, including securely and cost-effectively routing traffic across network boundaries (VPNs, service meshes, etc.)

  • Experience integrating LLM/AI tooling into developer workflows - e.g. Claude Code - both locally, and remotely.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence senior stakeholders and align multiple non-adjacent teams without formal authority over them.

  • Experience building close working relationships with the engineering teams who consume your platform, not just the platform team itself.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in developer platforms or adjacent infrastructure: devcontainers, remote development, remote IDE backends, or developer workstation tooling.

  • Practical experience with JetBrains remote-backend flows, Codespaces/Codeserver-style products, or equivalent.

  • Experience with remote build/execution systems (e.g. BuildBuddy), or large-scale build caching.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

data.title: S&O Manager - Rider Fraud
data.description:
About the role

This role will lead our approach to understanding and reducing courier/rider fraud and abuse across Wolt and Deliveroo. Combining data-led investigation with strong operational judgement, you will identify emerging risk patterns, understand the features of our operating models that may contribute to those risks, and assess their potential impact.

A key part of the role is turning insight into action. You will translate analysis into clear, proportionate policies and operational responses that protect platform integrity and customer outcomes, while remaining practical to implement and appropriate for the markets in which we operate. You will work closely with Legal, Public Policy, Product, Data Science and Operations to navigate complex legal and regulatory considerations and ensure our approach is effective, fair and robust.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead a programme of work to identify, assess and prioritise courier/rider fraud and abuse risks across Wolt and Deliveroo.

  • Translate identified risks into proportionate policy, process and operational responses, balancing risk reduction with customer outcomes, courier/rider experience and business practicality.

  • Lead the implementation, monitoring and ongoing refinement of fraud and abuse policies, with clear measures of effectiveness and residual risk.

  • Ensure policy approaches are developed with appropriate consideration of legal, regulatory, compliance and reputational implications.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build a deep understanding of our courier/rider operating models, incentive structures and end-to-end journeys to identify where fraud or abuse risk may arise, using data, operational knowledge and structured, hypothesis-led analysis.

  • Develop analytical approaches and key metrics to identify patterns, quantify impact, assess detection signals and measure the effectiveness of policy interventions over time.

  • Define new policies, or revise existing ones, in response to identified risks that may negatively affect customers, couriers/riders, the platform or the wider business.

You'll own the onboarding experience - running structured welcome calls with new clients, walking them through what we do, what to expect from our team, and what their key obligations are as a business.   • Lead 30–45 minute structured onboarding video calls with new clients using a prepared script, covering our services, their statutory obligations, and what they can expect from us

  • Document and hand over all relevant information to the Customer Service and Retention teams at the close of onboarding

  • Spot early risks (e.g. clients who seem disengaged or behind on setup) and escalate to relevant stakeholders

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience running client-facing onboarding calls, welcome calls, or structured video-based client sessions - this is the most important thing we're hiring for

  • A natural communicator: warm, structured, and able to put people at ease on a call

  • Confident explaining processes and obligations to clients who are new to accounting and business admin

  • Basic familiarity with UK statutory requirements for small businesses (e.g. Corporation Tax, Self-Assessment, VAT thresholds, PAYE) - you don't need to be an accountant, but you should be able to explain these clearly to a first-time founder
